programs.desc: In Amboseli, Kenya, an incredibly rare drought event pushes a struggling elephant family to its limits as their only chance to save their dynasty is to work together and overcome the challenge of a lifetime.

programs.title: Planet Earth: Dynasties II
programs.desc: On Zambia's plains, a cheetah mother and her three growing daughters must travel thousands of kilometers every year to roam their vast territory searching for food; new challenges arise as the wet season arrives and floodwaters advance.

programs.title: Planet Earth: Dynasties II
programs.desc: On the vast Zambian plains, a clan of hyenas must pull together to survive; the seemingly desolate territory could be the key to their success, and holding onto it until the wildebeest return will be vital for the clan's survival.

programs.title: Planet Earth: Dynasties II
programs.desc: High in the mountains of Morocco lives a descendant of a long line of macaque rulers who has been in charge of her troupe for many winters - one of the longest recorded reigns of an alpha - but this year is likely to be her last.

programs.title: Planet Earth: Dynasties II
programs.desc: A mother puma must battle rivals, tackle prey nearly three times her size and endure the wild mountain weather of Patagonia in her bid to raise four cubs, her biggest litter yet.

programs.title: Commando
programs.desc: Retired Special Forces soldier John Matrix (Arnold Schwarzenegger) lives with daughter Jenny (Alyssa Milano) in isolation, but his privacy is disturbed by former commander Franklin Kirby (James Olson), who warns him that his fellow soldiers are getting killed one by one. After Kirby leaves, Jenny is kidnapped by former Latin American dictator Arius (Dan Hedaya), who wants Matrix to restore him to power. Instead, Matrix sets out to take down the rogue leader and rescue his daughter.
